name: KiCad Multichannel Layout
description: Copy placement and routing between repeated PCB channels.
description_full: A preview-first native IPC plugin for copying matched footprint placement and verified routing between named PCB groups, and repairing routing group membership. Locked items are preserved. Copy ignores zones and routed arcs. Inspect results and run DRC. Requires KiCad 10 and Python 3.11 or newer.
